# ZenResume — llms.txt

> ZenResume (https://www.zenresume.online) is a 100% free, privacy-first, local-first ATS resume builder and career acceleration platform developed by Aneevarp Solutions. It enables job seekers, software engineers, freshers, and professionals to create machine-readable, recruiter-approved single-column vector PDF resumes with zero paywalls, watermark fees, or forced account creation.

## Core Capabilities & Features
- **100% Free Forever ($0.00):** No subscription paywalls, no watermark fees, and no credit cards required to download resumes.
- **Enterprise ATS Single-Column Layouts:** Strictly enforces parser-approved single-column structures tested across Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, and Lever.
- **Pure Vector PDF Compilation Engine:** Compiles sharp, selectable-text PDFs with crystal-clear vector typography (Inter, Roboto) rather than rasterized canvas screenshots.
- **63 Role-Specific Resume Templates:** Pre-configured templates with industry-tested, quantifiable action bullets (CAR/XYZ formula) for Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Accountants, Nurses, and Managers.
- **Gemini AI Magic Import (Optional):** Intelligently extracts, cleans, and structures messy PDF resumes or raw text into clean ATS templates in seconds.
- **Real-Time Job Description Matcher:** Instant keyword scan comparing resume text against LinkedIn/Indeed job postings to reveal missing ATS keywords.
- **Live Visual Customizer:** Granular font sizing, line-height sliders, margin controls, and 1-click single page auto-fit.
- **1-Click Portable Backups:** Export and import entire resume profiles as portable `.zenresume` / JSON files with zero vendor lock-in.
- **Aneevarp Solutions Career Ecosystem:** Integrated with ZenScout AI (https://ai-job-search-agent-chi.vercel.app/), an autonomous multi-agent job hunting and live mock interview platform.

## Architecture & Privacy
- **Local-First Browser Execution:** All user data, contact details, work history, and education remain stored strictly inside the user's browser (IndexedDB and localStorage).
- **Zero Remote Data Harvesting:** ZenResume operates zero centralized databases that collect, harvest, or sell user resume profiles.
- **Statutory Compliance:** Fully compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act 2023), GDPR, and IT Intermediary Rules 2021/2023.
- **Data Subject Rights:** Full Right to Access (portable JSON export), Right to Erasure / Right to be Forgotten (1-click client cache reset), and designated Statutory Grievance Redressal Desk.

## Pricing & Plans
ZenResume operates on a transparent, 100% Free public utility model supported by non-intrusive contextual advertisements and affiliate partnerships.

| Tier | Price | Features & Limits |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Community Free Tier** | **$0.00 / Free Forever** | Unlimited PDF exports, all 63 role templates, Gemini AI Magic Import, ATS scanner, 100% local storage privacy, zero watermarks. |
| **Enterprise / Campus Suite** | **Free for Universities** | Campus training suite and placement portal integration for educational institutions. |
